messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — AcmeHealth returned the vendor intake with 6 follow-up Qs. Main asks: embeddings retention policy, backup encryption, and BYOK/KMS attestation. They want answers and evidence by EOD Thu.

jordan_se: I can own the KMS/BYOK questions. need the key list and any attestation text we already have.

olivia_cs: I’ll draft the retention + deletion workflow answers. can someone share actual retention windows per env? staging vs prod.

legal_ben: looping in legal review — do not promise BYOK specifics until we confirm vendor contract. I can approve redacted attestation if needed.

sec_bot: Automated checklist: missing items -> [data-flow diagram, KMS attestation, SOC2 scoping doc]. See: https://inbox.redwood/attachments/ACME-INTAKE-2026

sanjay_eng: I’ll pull the infra diagram and kms config. sample commands I’ll run and include in evidence zip:```
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-prod --query KeyMetadata --output json
kubectl get secret redis-kms -n prod -o yaml
```

maria_cs: Perfect. Jordan — can you prepare a short attestation template? Olivia — once you have the retention draft I’ll merge and run by Ben. I’ll aim to send bundle to Acme by Thu 10:30am PT.

jordan_se: Will draft template now and drop in the thread. expect by 12pm. :thumbsup:

olivia_cs: retention draft uploaded to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4821. PT notes: embeddings kept 90 days, logs 365 days, customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated + Private only.

maria_cs: Note for the record: if they ask for full BYOK in hosted, we need legal escalation — bring options (redacted attestation, Dedicated offering).

legal_ben: Agreed. If they push for hosted BYOK, we can propose Dedicated or contract addendum.

sec_bot: Reminder: add data-flow diagram with S3 bucket ARNs and retention lines. Missing: proof of backups encryption-at-rest and cross-region replication notes.

sanjay_eng: Attaching diagram to ticket in 10m and packaging evidence zip. Will include commands, diagrams, and config snippets.

maria_cs: Thanks team — follow-ups: 1) Jordan = KMS attestation template, 2) Olivia = retention workflow + screenshot of retention job, 3) Sanjay = infra diagram + configs. Ben will review. I’ll consolidate and send.

olivia_cs: quick q — for the retention screenshot do we want the scheduler UI or the cron logs? cron logs better for auditors?

legal_ben: Cron logs + short explanation. redact any PII in logs.

jordan_se: Draft attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms keys are customer-managed where applicable; KMS key IDs provided upon contract execution; backups encrypted at rest using AES-256; production keys rotated annually." Pls review.

maria_cs: that looks good. Ben — any redaction suggestions?

legal_ben: Wording ok, add "subject to contract terms" line. Then good to go.

maria_cs: Great — next step: assemble evidence zip, review with Ben, send to customer. Will update thread when sent. :raised_hands:
